I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm I've noted that Maren Tolland is his go-to escalation contact at Tansley Parcel for the Linden rollout.

The workspace brain (gbrain) saves direct messages automatically and shows them only to the person who sent them. I didn't save a separate note because the save tool had no clear way to keep a note private. I can pull this up whenever Hollis asks, and it won't come up in anyone else's conversations or in channels.
